course.note: Estimate from the mapped river line upstream of the dock. Not checked on the water.

copy.description: Go, caution or stay off: rowing conditions on the tidal Potomac at Thompson Boat Center, Washington, DC.
copy.flowStats: Since 2016 the median day at Little Falls is about 6,500 cfs. 22,000 is the top 12% of days, 35,000 the top 5%.
copy.flowHow: Flow is measured at the USGS gauge at Little Falls, about 5 mi upstream in a straight line. The forecast is from the NWS Middle Atlantic River Forecast Center for the same gauge. At the dock the tide also moves the water.
copy.credits: Forecast from [Open-Meteo](https://open-meteo.com/). Alerts, including the marine zone for the tidal Potomac, and Reagan National observations from the [National Weather Service, Baltimore/Washington](https://www.weather.gov/lwx/). River flow and water temperature from USGS gauge [01646500 at Little Falls](https://waterdata.usgs.gov/monitoring-location/USGS-01646500/). River and tide forecasts from the [NWS Middle Atlantic River Forecast Center](https://water.noaa.gov/gauges/gtnd2). Air quality from Open-Meteo (Copernicus CAMS), and the model comparison from GFS, ECMWF, GEM and ICON via Open-Meteo.
